facts.fact: 母亲死后 Lucas 睡折叠床把床让给她、抱着她熬过恸哭、强行喂汤——她欠他一条命
facts.anchor: Lucas slept on a cot in the gathering room so Andra could sleep in his bed

facts.fact: 蓝色光球现身引路，忽近忽远像跳舞；母亲说过魔法只向它认可的人显形
facts.anchor: A small blue light appeared a short distance away, floating at eye level.

facts.fact: 黑湖水仙 Egeria 自报家门：世代住在 Brashen 黑湖，魔法从没像追随她这样追过谁
facts.anchor: “I am Egeria, a naiad and protector of the Black Lake of Brashen.

facts.fact: Egeria 预言：大陆将生大变，她处在变化的中心，好坏未知
facts.anchor: “There is a great change on the horizon for the continent of Brashen, and I sense you have a role in that change.

facts.fact: 入水幻象：Edgeron 与 Cecilia 的最终决战，光暗缠斗，Cecilia 是仅存的光系
facts.anchor: Shadow and light clashed and tangled in a vicious attempt to gain control

facts.fact: Cecilia 临终独白怜悯 Edgeron 从未体会人生简单快乐，随后倾尽余力把他从内部照亮而死
facts.anchor: “I feel bad for you. That you never experienced the simple joys of life.”

facts.fact: 银发女人跪抱 Edgeron 尸体吻他冷唇发誓复仇：暗魔法要征服一切，Cecilia 会付出代价
facts.anchor: “My love,” the woman sobbed as she cradled his face and kissed his cold lips.

facts.fact: 女人摘下颈上大翡翠放在 Edgeron 胸口，以咒语把尸体里的暗影吸进绿宝石
facts.anchor: She pulled a chain from around her neck, and a large emerald dangled from it.

facts.fact: 归岸后 Egeria 揭名：那女人就是 Vasara，跟他一样恶毒；是爱让人做最恶之事
facts.anchor: “Vasara,” Egeria nodded. “Nearly as vile as he was.

facts.fact: Egeria 收尾：母亲带着许多秘密来南方林子定居；你是她的继承人，必须准备、必须走
facts.anchor: “Your mother bore many secrets when she came to dwell in the Southern Woods.
